{{Quote|We're fighting a war against Black Sun. Wish I could say we're winning.|Stansun|<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />}}
'''Stansun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic, [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] Stansun was assigned to the [[Black Sun territory]]. Though Stansun remained positive, he was frustrated by the lack of progress in fighting the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. He had tried several times to shut down an illegal [[Black Sun's clinic|surgery clinic]] without success before he was able to enlist the help of a Republic individual.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Word has it they're running an illegal surgery clinic, giving wanted criminals new faces. Helps them dodge arrest.|Stansun, discussing Black Sun|<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />}}
Stansun was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], Stansun served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] under the Republic government.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" /> Around [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> he was assigned to the [[Black Sun territory]] where he attempted to shut down an illegal [[Black Sun's clinic|surgical clinic]] run by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate. The clinic was used to change the faces of known criminals to prevent the CSF from identifying them. However, every time CSF moved in to shut down the clinic, Black Sun moved to a different location at the sight of the CSF uniforms. [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] Stansun was able to enlist the help of a Republic individual to shut down the clinic.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The individual was able to [[Raid on the Black Sun's clinic|infiltrate]] the clinic and defeat Black Sun's [[Thug/Legends|thugs]] as well as several [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The individual destroyed the clinic's [[Medical droid/Legends|surgical droids]] to prevent Black Sun from reopening the clinic and downloaded a list of criminals the clinic's [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had operated on. The list was then turned over to Stansun so that CSF could identify the criminals' faces and track them down.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The sooner we can shut them down, the faster we can clean up Coruscant.|Stansun, discussing Black Sun|<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />}}
Stansun was a Human male with light skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and beard. While he kept a positive attitude, Stansun was realistic about the fighting between the police and Black Sun. Even with the CSF seemingly losing the battle, Stansun remained determined to press on. He was certain that with Black Sun gone, peace could be brought to Coruscant.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />

==Equipment==
Stansun wore a gray and brown [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with yellow patterning. He also made use of brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], brown [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]] on which he carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stansun appears as part of "The Face Merchants" quest in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] by [[BioWare]] released in [[2011]]. The mission can be completed by a Republic character who meets Stansun in the Black Sun Territory and then proceeds to the clinic. The quest provides no light side or dark side choice but can be refused.<ref name="SWTORfacemerch" /> Stansun was voiced by [[Dude Walker]],<ref name="VO1">{{YouTube|video=cgxOjSlCHU0|text=Star Wars - The Old Republic - Dude Walker voiceover|channel=@dudevo3833|name=Dude Walker|quote=Security Officer Stansun - Dude Walker voiceover}}</ref> who also voiced [[Ardun Kothe]] in the Imperial Agent storyline.<ref name="VO2">{{YouTube|video=Rq7cPqT9VCI|text=Dude Walker Animation/Videogame VO Demo|channel=channel/UCB5HYX4AX7WaGjmVP290FjA|name=Dude Walker}}</ref>
